q: The variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) is a hybrid classical-quantum algorithm for estimating ground state energies. It uses:
opts: A parameterized quantum circuit (ansatz) optimized classically via minimizing ⟨ψ(θ)|H|ψ(θ)⟩
exp: VQE: prepare a parameterized state |ψ(θ)⟩ on quantum hardware, estimate ⟨H⟩ = ⟨ψ(θ)|H|ψ(θ)⟩ via measurements, then optimize θ classically. The variational principle guarantees the energy estimate bounds the ground state energy from above.
